claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by defining deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
Advanced CFO-aligned adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization by connecting enterprise workflow adoption with usage-based forecasting and customer deal support.
Strengthened production agentic AI reliability with audit-grade observability across regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates across intake, execution, monitoring, and remediation, enabling managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data flows, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.
